cases.title: With both Undo switches on, CD's [Undo] takes back point 3, Enter finishes a straight two-point pipe, and one U after placing it echoes CD and takes the pipe away
cases.plan_item: UX-UNDO-01 profile B, switch-on setting (daily card D19 assertion 1 for a placed CD pipe; N07 covers the rest)
cases.expected: CD with points 150000,-85000, 160000,-85000 and 165000,-87000, then U at the [Undo] prompt prints 'Undid: point 3 of the pipe route.'; Enter finishes the route on the first two points and New Pipe opens; with inverts 18.000 / 17.950 Start Pipe places exactly one pipe whose box starts at x 150000 and stays above y -86000 (the taken-back point at y -87000 is not in it), with the two IL texts IL 18.000 and IL 17.950; one U echoes CD and leaves nothing new in the drawing.
cases.why_not_unit: AutoCAD's own undo echo and the live CD prompt keyword are only visible in a running session, and the switches are read from the real settings file at start-up.
not_automated: The settings switches are OFF in Tim's file: this case proves the switch-on setting only (N17 proves Tim's own switches).
REDO after the U is not driven (BUG-861 family; R08).
